lines.en: label christmastwo4:
scene wintersky
The work week comes to a close, but not without reminding me one final time on my way out of the building that, at least for a little while longer, I’m going to have to keep dealing with snow.
lines.zh: 工作日画上了句号，但在我走出教学楼时，它仍不忘最后再提醒我一次：至少在接下来的一阵子里，我还得继续跟雪打交道。

lines.en: You know, when winter first began, I didn’t really expect to come to hate it as much as I have.
lines.zh: 要知道，冬天刚开始的时候，我真没料到自己对它的厌恶会深到这个地步。

lines.en: But I guess it’s kind of inevitable that you'll wind up hating something when you’re both surrounded and inconvenienced by it multiple times a week.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，当你每周被同一样东西包围、又被它折腾好几次，最后恨上它，大概也是不可避免的。

lines.en: Obviously there are exceptions to that rule- like the one with red hair who makes me breakfast every morning.
lines.zh: 这条规则显然有例外——比如那个每天早晨给我做早饭的红发姑娘。

lines.en: Or the blonde one that I came inside of earlier today.
lines.zh: 还有今天早些时候我射在里面的那个金发姑娘。

lines.en: But most things are only good in moderation, so I think I should be forgiven for suddenly wanting something other than the thing I wanted originally.
lines.zh: 但大多数东西只有在适量时才美好，所以我想，我突然想要点跟最初想要的不同的东西，应该是可以被原谅的。

lines.en: And, soon enough, I’m sure I’ll be silently complaining about the heat again instead.
lines.zh: 而且很快，我肯定又会开始默默地抱怨天气热了。

lines.en: But at least then, I won’t be wet.
lines.zh: 但至少到那时候，我不会是湿的。

lines.en: I move through the streets in hope of maybe finding someone who can make my journey to the dorms a little less boring, but I left school late enough that the chances of that seem unlikely.
lines.zh: 我在街上走着，希望能碰上什么人，让回宿舍的这段路不那么无聊，可我离开学校太晚了，看来希望不大。

lines.en: I probably could have asked Imani to come with me, but I think I could use a little break from her since she was the reason I had to stay late.
lines.zh: 我本来可以叫 Imani 一起走，不过我觉得还是该跟她稍微拉开点距离，毕竟我被迫留到那么晚，就是拜她所赐。

lines.en: Apparently, just having a beautiful woman show up to teach my class in my stead isn’t as easy as it sounds.
lines.zh: 看来，光是让一个漂亮女人来代替我上课，并不像听起来那么轻松。

lines.en: But maybe this could be good for me?
lines.zh: 但这也许对我有好处？

lines.en: Not in the fact that it will surely detract from the amount of time I’m able to focus on things like my seemingly indefinite life in Kumon-mi or the frequency of my masturbatorial habits-
lines.zh: 倒不是说它肯定会削减我能用来专注思考的时间——比如我在 Kumon-mi 看似无尽的人生，或者我自慰的频率之类的——

lines.en: But in the fact that I’ll feel a little better about constantly dragging everyone down alongside me if they’re learning something during their descent.
lines.zh: 而是说，如果大家在跟着我一起往下沉的过程中还能学到点东西，那我对「总是把所有人一起拖下水」这件事，心里会好受一些。

lines.en: Is that something I should have been able to accomplish on my own without the help of a student teacher? Yes.
lines.zh: 这种事，我本该在不用实习老师帮忙的情况下自己做到吗？是的。

lines.en: But convincing myself to do anything when it’s as cold out as this is impossible.
lines.zh: 可是天这么冷的时候，说服自己去做任何事都是不可能的。

lines.en: And convincing myself to do anything when it’s warmer is just as hard.
lines.zh: 而天暖和的时候，说服自己去做任何事也同样难。

lines.en: scene black
But what’s not hard is ignoring all of that and falling back into place.
lines.zh: 但不难的是，把这些全都无视掉，然后重新回到原位。

lines.en: I take a moment to dodge the shards of a shattered mirror falling from the sky disguised as snowflakes and, instead, let any chance of self-reflection be crushed beneath my feet.
lines.zh: 我花了一点时间，躲开那些伪装成雪花、从天上落下的碎镜子残片，转而把任何自我反省的机会都踩碎在脚下。

lines.en: After all, the school week is over.
lines.zh: 毕竟，这一周的学校生活结束了。

lines.en: Which means it’s time for me to return to the better part of my life.
lines.zh: 这意味着，是时候回到我人生中更好的那一部分了。

lines.en: The part where nothing can go wrong.
lines.zh: 那个不会出岔子的部分。

lines.en: The part where I can do no wrong.
lines.zh: 那个我不会做错事的部分。

lines.en: And so I make my way to a home away from home-
lines.zh: 于是我朝着另一个家走去——

lines.en: And find solace in one more place where I don’t have to dodge anything.
lines.zh: 并在又一个不必躲闪任何东西的地方，找到了慰藉。

lines.en: : Come in!
lines.zh: : 进来！

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes1
: Uhh...surprise!
lines.zh: : 呃……惊喜！

lines.en: : You know, I’ve been thinking. How did you even manage to make it this big? Like...where the heck did you have room to even build this?
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我一直在想。你到底是怎么把它做得这么大的？就是……你到底哪儿来的地方做这个啊？

lines.en: : Uhh...what is it?
lines.zh: : 呃……这是什么？

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes2
: Oh, you know. Just a...wardrobe...closet...thing...
lines.zh: : 哦，你知道的。就是个……衣柜……壁橱……之类的东西……

lines.en: : Wow, how did you know that “wardrobe closet thing” was at the top of my Christmas list this year?
lines.zh: : 哇，你怎么知道「衣柜壁橱之类的东西」就在我今年圣诞愿望清单的第一位？

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes3
: I know! I went totally overboard! But I felt weird about giving you two toys in a row when you’re an adult and...can probably benefit from additional storage space!
lines.zh: : 我知道！我做得实在太过了！但我觉得，连续两年都送你玩具怪怪的，毕竟你是成年人，而且……应该能受益于额外的收纳空间！

lines.en: : How am I even supposed to get this home?
lines.zh: : 这玩意儿我要怎么弄回家啊？

lines.en: : I don’t know, but you better friggin’ figure it out because our room’s starting to get a little cramped.
lines.zh: : 我不知道，但你最好给我想想办法，因为我们房间已经开始有点挤了。

lines.en: : Starting?
lines.zh: : 开始？

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes4
: I can...probably help carry it?
lines.zh: : 我……大概能帮忙搬？

lines.en: : Sure. I’ll just carry a giant wardrobe across town with a girl who could probably get swept away by the wind at any given moment.
lines.zh: : 行啊。我就这么扛着一个巨大的衣柜穿过全城，身边还跟着一个随时可能被风刮跑的女孩。

lines.en: : How much does renting one of those moving van thingies cost? Maybe we could get one of those for a few hours.
lines.zh: : 租一辆那种搬家货车要多少钱？也许我们可以租一辆用几个小时。

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes5
: Oh! And then we could have a party at your place! And this time, we won’t let Noriko come so you can stay conscious for the whole thing!
lines.zh: : 哦！然后我们还可以在你家开派对！而且这次我们不让 Noriko 来，这样你全程都能保持清醒！

lines.en: : I feel like I’m missing a very important detail here.
lines.zh: : 我觉得我好像漏掉了什么很重要的细节。

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it, Io. And thank you for the...very large and random present.
lines.zh: : 别管了，Io。还有，谢谢你这份……又大又随意的礼物。

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes6
: Do...you hate it?
lines.zh: : 你……讨厌它吗？

lines.en: : I don’t hate it. I just have no idea where to put it. Or even what to put in it.
lines.zh: : 我不讨厌。我只是不知道该把它放哪儿。甚至不知道该往里面放什么。

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes7
: Don’t worry about that, Master! Every Ichimonji wardrobe is sized to perfectly fit Uta-chan for her new, traveling maid business!
lines.zh: : 这点不用担心，主人！每一件 Ichimonji 衣柜的尺寸，都是为了让 Uta-chan 完美适配、方便她开展新的上门女仆生意而设计的！

lines.en: : Just bring me a drink of water and some pizza rolls every night and I can live in here for the rest of forever!
lines.zh: : 只要你每天晚上给我拿杯水、拿点披萨卷，我就能在这儿住到天荒地老！

lines.en: : I don’t think Sensei wants to-
lines.zh: : 我觉得老师不会想——

lines.en: : Sold. I’ll take ten.
lines.zh: : 成交。我要十个。

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes8
: Ten?!
lines.zh: : 十个？！

lines.en: : How am I going to get all of the materials for ten of these things? This wasn’t exactly easy to make.
lines.zh: : 我上哪儿去弄十个这玩意儿的材料啊？这做起来可不轻松。

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you be a liiiiiittle more worried about where you’re gonna find nine other Utas?
lines.zh: : 你是不是该稍微担点心，上哪儿再找九个 Uta？

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes9
: Nah. I’ll just go back to our chat room thingy and see if there are any other girls with dying grandpas who can fit into small closets.
lines.zh: : 不用。我回头去我们那个聊天室看看，有没有别的小到能塞进柜子里、爷爷又快死了的女孩。

lines.en: : That doesn’t sound that hard.
lines.zh: : 听起来也不算太难。

lines.en: : Those poor grandpas...
lines.zh: : 那些可怜的爷爷们……

lines.en: : Dying grandparents and chat rooms aside, I feel kind of bad now for not getting you anything. Especially when you made something as ridiculous as this.
lines.zh: : 抛开将死的祖父母和聊天室不谈，我现在有点过意不去了，因为我什么都没给你。尤其是你还做了这么离谱的东西。

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes10
: I don’t need anything from you, Sensei. Buying anything for me would just be a waste of money anyway.
lines.zh: : 我不需要你的任何东西，老师。给我买什么都是在浪费钱。

lines.en: : It wouldn’t be a waste, Io.
lines.zh: : 那不是浪费，Io。

lines.en: : No, no. It really would. Not just because I suck, but because all of the things I like can be found in dumpsters and discount warehouses and stuff. Material goods don’t really matter to me.
lines.zh: : 不，不。真的会浪费。不光是因为我很差劲，还因为我喜欢的所有东西，都能在垃圾箱和折扣仓库之类的地方找到。物质对我来说真的不重要。

lines.en: : That’s a weird thing for someone who makes material goods as a hobby to say.
lines.zh: : 一个以做实物为爱好的人，说这种话可真奇怪。

lines.en: : Okay, so maybe I didn’t word that correctly. But you should know by now that I am the human equivalent of a duffel bag full of contradictions.
lines.zh: : 好吧，也许我措辞不当。但你早该知道了，我就是「一个装满矛盾的行李袋」的人类等价物。

lines.en: : How can you have a human equivalent of an object that doesn’t actually exist?
lines.zh: : 一个根本不存在的东西，怎么会有人的等价物？

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes11
: Duffel bags are real, Sensei. Just because they’re full of something intangible doesn’t mean they don’t exist at all. It’s what’s outside that counts.
lines.zh: : 行李袋是真的存在的，老师。它们装满某种无形的东西，并不意味着它们根本不存在。重要的是外面那个。

lines.en: : I think that’s the opposite of how that phrase is supposed to work.
lines.zh: : 我觉得这句话的用法正好跟原意相反吧。

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes12
: Then...maybe the phrase needs to be changed?
lines.zh: : 那么……也许这句话该改改了？

lines.en: : I’m confused.
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。

lines.en: : In the future, if you ever want to give me a return present or anything like that, just give me a hug. I’ll always accept one of those from you.
lines.zh: : 以后，如果你想回送我礼物什么的，就给我一个拥抱吧。我永远都会接受你的拥抱。

lines.en: : Which isn’t me insinuating that I want you to hug me right now. Even though I do. I just understand that you’re still probably put off by the fact that I made you something so large that-
lines.zh: : 这不是在暗示我想让你现在就抱我。虽然我确实想。我只是明白，你大概还在因为我给你做了个这么大的东西而……

lines.en: : Just fucking hug him, Io.
lines.zh: : 直接他妈抱他啊，Io。

lines.en: : Can I? Please?
lines.zh: : 可以吗？拜托？

lines.en: : I don’t know. I still feel kind of put off by the fact that you made me something so large that-
lines.zh: : 我不知道。我还在因为你给我做了个这么大的东西而有点……

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes13
: Hug the Io, damn it!
lines.zh: : 抱住那个 Io，该死的！

lines.en: : Do you have any idea how much she busted her butt on this thing? The least you can do is give her some of that sweet, G-rated loving!
lines.zh: : 你知道她为这玩意儿拼了多大劲吗？你至少也该给她一点那种甜甜的、全年龄级的爱吧！

lines.en: : Okay, fine. Go.
lines.zh: : 好吧，好吧。来吧。

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes14
: Woo! Hug-based victory! All of the calluses and splinters are suddenly worth it!
lines.zh: : 呜呼！拥抱大捷！所有的老茧和木刺突然都值了！

lines.en: : You should value your time and talent more. This sort of payment would never hold up in the business world.
lines.zh: : 你该更看重自己的时间和才华。这种报酬在商界可是站不住脚的。

lines.en: : That might be true! But you know what else is true?
lines.zh: : 也许吧！但你知道还有什么也是真的吗？

lines.en: : What, Io?
lines.zh: : 什么，Io？

lines.en: : I like you.
lines.zh: : 我喜欢你。

lines.en: : Yes, you’ve made that quite apparent.
lines.zh: : 是啊，你表现得够明显了。

lines.en: : Let’s run away together. All three of us.
lines.zh: : 我们私奔吧。我们三个一起。

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes15
: Wait a sec, I’m coming too?
lines.zh: : 等一下，我也要去？

lines.en: : Of course you are. You’re my best friend. Do you have any idea how awesome it would be to leave everything behind except for you two?
lines.zh: : 当然了。你是我最好的朋友。你知道把一切抛在身后、只带上你们俩，会有多棒吗？

lines.en: I obviously have no intention of doing any of this, but I guess it’s fine to let Io fantasize for a little while.
lines.zh: 我显然一点都不打算真的去做这些，不过我想，让 Io 稍微幻想一会儿也没关系。

lines.en: One hug in exchange for tens of hours of work isn’t really fair, so I’ll just consider this an added bonus that tips the scale a little further in my favor.
lines.zh: 用一个拥抱换几十个小时的劳动，实在算不上公平，所以我就把这当成一点额外的补偿，好让天平再往我这边歪一点。

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes16
: Where...would we go?
lines.zh: : 我们……要去哪儿？

lines.en: : Wait, are you actually considering this?
lines.zh: : 等等，你真的在考虑这事？

lines.en: : Anywhere and everywhere. Just the three of us.
lines.zh: : 任何地方，所有地方。就我们三个。

lines.en: : That sounds...nice, but...
lines.zh: : 听起来……不错，但是……

lines.en: : You know, I just can’t see myself having fun watching you two all...huggy all the time.
lines.zh: : 我啊，实在想象不出，看着你俩整天……抱来抱去有什么好玩的。

lines.en: : I am definitely not a “huggy” person.
lines.zh: : 我绝对不是个「爱抱来抱去」的人。

lines.en: : You wanna join in? We’ve got room for one more.
lines.zh: : 你想加入吗？我们还容得下一个。

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes17
: Oh, no...That’s your present. I didn’t get Sensei anything, so...I’d just be getting in the way.
lines.zh: : 哦，不……那是你的礼物。我什么都没给老师，所以……我只会碍事。

lines.en: : Suit yourself then. He’s really comfy. And suspiciously cold.
lines.zh: : 那随你便。他抱起来真的很舒服。而且可疑的凉。

lines.en: : I don’t see what’s suspicious about walking here in the snow, but I’m glad to hear that you’re comfortable.
lines.zh: : 我不觉得在雪地里走过来有什么可疑的，不过很高兴听到你觉得舒服。

lines.en: : Now, if you could please let go, I’d like to make arrangements for how exactly I’m going to get this thing out of here...
lines.zh: : 那么，如果你能松手的话，我想安排一下，到底该怎么把这玩意儿弄出去……

lines.en: scene dodgingsnowflakes14
: You really don’t hate it, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 你真的不讨厌它吗，老师？

lines.en: : No. And I didn’t hate the robot either. Stop assuming I’m just going to hate everything that you do when history very much begs to differ.
lines.zh: : 不讨厌。那个机器人我也没有讨厌。别总以为我会讨厌你做的每件事——历史可是明明白白地证明了相反的情况。

lines.en: : I make no promises.
lines.zh: : 我不做任何保证。

lines.en: : Oh! And, I forgot to ask earlier, but are you coming to the Christmas party tomorrow? Because you being there directly influences whether or not yours truly will be in attendance.
lines.zh: : 哦！还有，我之前忘了问，你明天来圣诞派对吗？因为你去不去，直接决定了本人会不会出席。

lines.en: : I will, but don’t take that as me agreeing to spend the entire party with you since I normally wind up getting pulled around at events like this.
lines.zh: : 我会去的，但别把这当成我同意整场派对都陪着你，因为在这种场合，我通常都会被到处拉来拉去。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I don’t mind pulling a little bit. It’s good exercise.
lines.zh: : 没关系。我不介意拉一拉。就当锻炼身体了。

lines.en: : Then I will see both you and Uta tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 那明天见，你们两个。

lines.en: : Yeah...
: It should be fun.
lines.zh: : 应该会很有趣。

lines.en: : Do you want me to just keep the wardrobe closet thing right where it is until you can figure out how to get it out of here?
lines.zh: : 你要不要先把这个衣柜壁橱的东西就放这儿，等你想好怎么把它弄出去再说？

lines.en: : I mean...do you have other options for where you could put it?
lines.zh: : 我是说……你还有别的地方能放它吗？

lines.en: : No. I don’t know why I asked that. I’m an idiot. No wonder you won’t date me.
lines.zh: : 没有。我不知道我为什么要问这个。我是个白痴。难怪你不肯跟我交往。

lines.en: scene black
: Okay, that’s enough hugging for tonight.
lines.zh: : 好了，今晚抱够了。

lines.en: : I completely understand and thank you for managing to put up with it for so long.
lines.zh: : 我完全理解，也谢谢你忍了这么久。

lines.en: : Right. Well, I’ll see you two tomorrow, I guess.
lines.zh: : 好吧。那么，我想我们明天见了。

lines.en: : Okay! Goodnight, Sensei! See you tomorrow!
lines.zh: : 好的！晚安，老师！明天见！

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei.
lines.zh: : 晚安，老师。

lines.en: I make my way out of the dorm room and begin to flip through a mental list of contacts to determine who would best be able to help me with this.
lines.zh: 我走出宿舍房间，开始在脑子里翻通讯录，看谁最适合帮我这个忙。

lines.en: Within a matter of seconds, I’m able to cut the list down to just Haruka and Maki since they’re the only people I know who can drive.
lines.zh: 几秒钟之内，我就把名单缩到了 Haruka 和 Maki，因为她们是我认识的人里唯二会开车的。

lines.en: Well, Niki too, I guess- but she’s probably off being famous somewhere.
lines.zh: 嗯，大概还有 Niki——不过她大概在哪儿当名人呢。

lines.en: I’m not sure if either one of my choices has a vehicle large enough to fit my present but, at the same time, I-
lines.zh: 我不确定这两个人里，有没有谁的车能装下我这份礼物，但同时，我——

lines.en: $ christmastwo4 = True
jump christmastwo5
